I want to work on the onboarding flow of the app.

first off when I first install the app I can see the main library ui when the app first launches and appear, we should find a way to fix this so the app takes its time to make sure it appears on the first onboarding screen with no glitches or anything like that before it appears to the user. like preloading or something before the window pops up. None of the onboarding flow is animated at all so I also want to add the split text animation from reactbits to all the like titles on each screen

also in the first onboarding screen the mascot does not animate with its drift animation or any facial expressions [Image: image.png; ref=image_9129a166-d8f4-46b5-92f1-1f2cd77b4cda] 

the second onboarding flow doesnt actually even use any real images or media at all its just blank color cards [Image: image.png; ref=image_bb9dcd90-1145-4963-87dd-6704d3e9c410] . this needs to be fixed and it also needs to be an animated component so all the media and content is moving, the vision I have for this is like a combination of the drift wall, circular carousel, and infinite spiral components from reactbits from col. but I do also like the parallax floating image component from fancy components too.

we also need real images for the third onboarding screen [Image: image.png; ref=image_3c65882e-bb6c-40db-b3c7-3f7e38e4e915] . I would like an animation too to animate the second card finding and showing the image being searched for from the first card and the text. I think the grid reveal from rare ui in col is perfect for this. just leave out those little "generating" "creating image" tags and the like from the component [Image: image.png; ref=image_bad973b0-850e-4882-a2de-59dd3b0784ea]. 

for the last onboarding screen [Image: image.png; ref=image_8e6a8188-2764-4bef-9723-d40f48789afc] this needs the mascot animated and with facial expressions too. I would also like to replace the custom breadcrumb with the one from coss.com ui from col
